close_reason: Requires inconsistent backend role normalization to trigger; real backends using typed MailboxRole won't hit this. Close as P3 edge case.
description: mailbox.rs handle_mailbox_set create loop: the role uniqueness check queries all_mailboxes (pre-mutation snapshot) but also checks role_just_created by reading from the 'created' map. The created map stores the serialized backend response from create_object — including any server-modified fields. If the backend's create_object assigns a different role than what the client sent (e.g., normalizes role casing), the role_just_created check reads the backend-modified role from 'created' rather than the client-requested role. This means if the client requests role='INBOX' and the backend normalizes to 'inbox', the role conflict check in subsequent creates compares against 'inbox' (from created map) but the client-sent role 'INBOX' would not match — technically allowing two mailboxes to claim 'INBOX' and 'inbox' if the backend normalizes inconsistently. This is a real risk but requires specific backend behavior to trigger.
title: Mailbox destroy child check uses stale snapshot for creates in same request
